author: dav3yb
what_it_is: Pokemon Crystal (unhacked) save from a playthrough on the MiSTer FPGA Gameboy core, posted 2024-09-09 because PKHeX rejected its size; poster says it is 100% the FPGA core's output (re-saved on the core). Progress not described.
note: 33280 = 32768 SRAM + 512-byte footer. Footer starts with a 48-byte VBA/BGB-style MBC3 RTC block: 5 LE u32 live regs (26 1a 16 10 be), 5 LE u32 latched regs (same), then LE u64 timestamp 0x66de666a = 2024-09-09 03:07:22 UTC (matches post date); remaining 464 bytes 0xFF. Kaphotics in the thread confirms trimming 0x8200 -> 0x8020/0x8000. Uploader's filename has no (Rev 1); revision not stated. Served with content-disposition filename 'Pokemon - Crystal Version (USA, Europe).sav'.
